data.one_liner: Smooth, animated scrolling for mouse wheels, trackpads, keyboards, and programmatic scrolls.
data.what_it_does: Provides smooth scroll animations ported from Chromium for mouse wheels, trackpads, keyboards, and programmatic scrolls in Flutter. It includes built-in curves like ChromiumEaseInOut and ChromiumImpulse, alongside controllers and actions to handle customized scroll animations dynamically.
use_when: You want smooth scrolling behavior on desktop or web resembling Chromium browsers.
You need keyboard and programmatic scrolls to animate smoothly with automatically calculated durations.
You want custom physics-based scroll animations for trackpads and mouse wheels.
avoid_when: You only need the default platform-specific Flutter scroll physics.
You are building a mobile-first app where custom desktop/web scroll behaviors are unnecessary.
strengths: Ported directly from Chromium for identical browser-like smooth scrolling behavior.
Handles both precise trackpads and coarse mouse wheels uniformly.
Supports keyboard shortcut integrations via custom ScrollIntent actions.
weaknesses: Global usage with AnimatedPrimaryScrollController requires care if multiple scrollables share the primary controller.
Limited documentation outside of the provided example code.
